lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਲ ਖਰੀਦੀ ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mul khareedee laalaa golaa meraa naau sabhaagaa ||
lines.translation: I am Your slave, Your bonded servant, and so I am called fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee bachanee haat bikaanaa jit laaiaa tit laagaa ||1||
lines.translation: I sold myself at Your store in exchange for the Guru's Word; whatever You link me to, to that I am linked. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere laale kiaa chaturaaee ||
lines.translation: What cleverness can Your servant try with You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib kaa hukam na karanaa jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, I cannot carry out the Hukam of Your Command. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾ ਲਾਲੀ ਪਿਉ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maa laalee piu laalaa meraa hau laale kaa jaaiaa ||
lines.translation: My mother is Your slave, and my father is Your slave; I am the child of Your slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੀ ਨਾਚੈ ਲਾਲਾ ਗਾਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: laalee naachai laalaa gaavai bhagat karau teree raaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: My slave mother dances, and my slave father sings; I practice devotional worship to You, O my Sovereign Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਅਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਣੀ ਆਣੀ ਮੀਰਾ ਖਾਹਿ ਤ ਪੀਸਣ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: peeahi ta paanee aanee meeraa khaahi ta peesan jaau ||
lines.translation: If You wish to drink, then I shall get water for You; if You wish to eat, I shall grind the corn for You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪੈਰ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: pakhaa pheree pair malovaa japat rahaa teraa naau ||3||
lines.translation: I wave the fan over You, and wash Your feet, and continue to chant Your Name. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਾਲਾ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: loon haraamee naanak laalaa bakhasihi tudh vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: I have been untrue to myself, but Nanak is Your slave; please forgive him, by Your glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad daiaapat daataa tudh vin mukat na paaee ||4||6||
lines.translation: Since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You have been the merciful and generous Lord. Without You, liberation cannot be attained. ||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ਭੂਤਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee aakhai bhootanaa ko kahai betaalaa ||
lines.translation: Some call him a ghost; some say that he is a demon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ਆਦਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: koee aakhai aadamee naanak vechaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: Some call him a mere mortal; O, poor Nanak! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਆ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaiaa divaanaa saah kaa naanak bauraanaa ||
lines.translation: Crazy Nanak has gone insane, after his Lord, the King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau har bin avar na jaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I know of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਭੈ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau devaanaa jaaneeai jaa bhai devaanaa hoi ||
lines.translation: He alone is known to be insane, when he goes insane with the Fear of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ekee saahib baaharaa doojaa avar na jaanai koi ||2||
lines.translation: He recognizes none other than the One Lord and Master. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਏਕਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau devaanaa jaaneeai jaa ekaa kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: He alone is known to be insane, if he works for the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਦੂਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaanai khasam kaa doojee avar siaanap kaai ||3||
lines.translation: Recognizing the Hukam, the Command of his Lord and Master, what other cleverness is there? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau devaanaa jaaneeai jaa saahib dhare piaar ||
lines.translation: He alone is known to be insane, when he falls in love with his Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)daa jaanai aap kau avar bhalaa sa(n)saar ||4||7||
lines.translation: He sees himself as bad, and all the rest of the world as good. ||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu dhan sarab rahiaa bharapoor ||
lines.translation: This wealth is all-pervading, permeating all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh phirahi s jaanahi door ||1||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh wanders around, thinking that it is far away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so dhan vakhar naam ridai hamaarai ||
lines.translation: That commodity, the wealth of the Naam, is within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis too dehi tisai nisataarai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whoever You bless with it, is emancipated. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: na ihu dhan jalai na tasakar lai jaai ||
lines.translation: This wealth does not burn; it cannot be stolen by a thief.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਡੂਬੈ ਨ ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: na ihu dhan doobai na is dhan kau milai sajaai ||2||
lines.translation: This wealth does not drown, and its owner is never punished. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is dhan kee dekhahu vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: Gaze upon the glorious greatness of this wealth,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje maate anadin jaaee ||3||
lines.translation: and your nights and days will pass, imbued with celestial peace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik baat anoop sunahu nar bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Listen to this incomparably beautiful story, O my brothers, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: is dhan bin kahahu kinai param gat paaee ||4||
lines.translation: Tell me, without this wealth, who has ever obtained the supreme status? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਕਥ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak akath kee kathaa sunaae ||
lines.translation: Nanak humbly prays, I proclaim the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai ta ihu dhan paae ||5||8||
lines.translation: If one meets the True Guru, then this wealth is obtained. ||5||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰ ਸਰੁ ਸੋਸਿ ਲੈ ਸੋਮ ਸਰੁ ਪੋਖਿ ਲੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਤੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: soor sar sos lai som sar pokh lai jugat kar marat s sanaba(n)dh keejai ||
lines.translation: Heat up the sun energy of the right nostril, and cool down the moon energy of the left nostril; practicing this breath-control, bring them into perfect balance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: meen kee chapal siu jugat man raakheeai udai nah ha(n)s nah ka(n)dh chheejai ||1||
lines.translation: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall will not crumble. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂੜੇ ਕਾਇਚੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mooRe kaaiche bharam bhulaa ||
lines.translation: You fool, why are you deluded by doubt?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah cheeniaa paramaana(n)d bairaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You do not remember the detached Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਰ ਗਹੁ ਜਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਅਮਰ ਗਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਉ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ajar gahu jaar lai amar gahu maar lai bhraat taj chhod tau apiu peejai ||
lines.translation: Seize and burn the unbearable; seize and kill the imperishable; leave behind your doubts, and then, you shall drink in the Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: meen kee chapal siu jugat man raakheeai udai nah ha(n)s nah ka(n)dh chheejai ||2||
lines.translation: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||2||
